searchText: This sounds like it would *increase* volatility compared to 1559, as prices could swing a lot more? Separately, I would like to understand better the reason why gas price volatility dampening itself is a desired feature. Your answer seems to talk about other advantages but doesn't really explain why volatility dampening helps users. the users will pay lower fees because gas stations will have a less volatile signal on the high-price side.
